summary: Verified production-build preview fix for Dynopay/SafeDeal Next.js frontend. All 7 public routes return HTTP 200 in <1s, no 502s, no cold-compile stalls. Landing page reloaded 3x consecutively with load times 0.62s / 0.19s / 0.19s — well under the 5s regression threshold. Static /_next/static/*.js chunks and logo images serve 200. Client-side nav from `/` (Log in -> /auth/login, Start free -> /auth/register) works in the production bundle. Login card renders email input + Continue button + Google/GitHub SSO. Mobile 390x844 viewport: no horizontal overflow (docW=winW=390), hero visible above fold. Backend proxy through frontend origin: GET /api/public/tickers returns 200 JSON with 10 symbols. Console clean — 0 error-level messages captured on landing.

critical_code_review_comments: Nav items 'Log in' and 'Start free' are rendered as <button> elements with onClick handlers instead of <a href> anchors. This works but hurts accessibility, right-click open-in-new-tab, and prefetch. Consider using Next.js <Link> anchors for header nav (minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is now on production Next.js build (FRONTEND_MODE=production, next start on distDir .next-prod). All public routes serve in <1s. The Log in / Start free header entries are <button> not <a>, so future Playwright scripts should use get_by_text('Log in', exact=True) or get_by_role('button', name='Log in') rather than link/href selectors.
rca of the issue: Original issue: Next.js was running in `next dev` mode, which lazy-compiles each route on first hit (~14-20s, ~6GB RAM). Cloudflare/K8s ingress timed out => 502 Bad Gateway / blank page. Fix (already applied by main agent): scripts/start-frontend.sh now runs `next build` then `next start` when FRONTEND_MODE=production, producing prebuilt bundles in .next-prod. Verified: routes now respond in 0.2-0.6s and stay stable across repeated hits.
